title: Product over a binary cube split
statement: Let $M$ be a commutative monoid, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $f$ assign an element of $M$ to each $(k+1)$-tuple over the two-element field. The product of $f$ over all such tuples is the product of its values on the tuples whose last coordinate is $0$ and its values on the tuples whose last coordinate is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: f maps the (k+1)-dimensional binary cube to M
